name: Sta. Rita Hills
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

notes: Even at its eastern edge, Sta. Rita Hills is a very cool Winkler Region I.
Pinot Noir, about 65% of the vines, shows bright red cherry, ripe and often with a maraschino accent.
Chardonnay leans toward lemon, green apple or yellow apple, and in some sites toward mineral notes.
Its Syrah is often lean, with whole-cluster spice.

blurb.text: A Central Coast AVA in Santa Barbara County, in the western part of the Santa Ynez Valley AVA and entirely within it. Its name was shortened from Santa Rita Hills.
